title: UNI Gallery of Art Presents the 2026 Elena Diane Curris Biennial Design Exhibition: “Making Meaning: The Work of Dan Stiles”
summary_en: The showcase features the creations of internationally acclaimed designer and illustrator Dan Stiles alongside works by students and alumni from UNI’s Department of Art & Graphic Design.
